components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button: Graphite fill, compact 28px.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 11.2px; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.205 0 0)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0 0)); font: 500 12px/1.625 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.205 0 0)) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--background, #fff), 0 0 0 4px var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: 11.2px; background: var(--background, #fff); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font: 500 12px/1.625 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--input, oklch(0.922 0 0)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--background, #fff), 0 0 0 4px var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: PC Builder Shimmer Link
components.description: The one animated element: a light travelling around the border of the header's PC Builder link.
components.css: .ds-shimmer { position: relative; z-index: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(0.205 0 0); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font: 600 14px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: inset 0 -8px 10px #ffffff1f; transition: box-shadow .3s; } .ds-shimmer:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 -6px 10px #ffffff3f; } .ds-shimmer-spark { position: absolute; inset: -100%; z-index: -2; background: conic-gradient(from 225deg, transparent 0, oklch(0.985 0 0) 90deg, transparent 90deg); animation: ds-spin 6s linear infinite; filter: blur(2px); } .ds-shimmer-bg { position: absolute; inset: 0.05em; z-index: -1; border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(0.205 0 0); } .ds-shimmer:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px oklch(0.708 0 0); } @keyframes ds-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-shimmer-spark { animation: none; } }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact field with a hairline stroke and soft focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 28px; width: 240px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: 11.2px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--input, oklch(0.922 0 0)) 20%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font: 400 12px/1.625 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 30%, transparent); }

components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; width: 220px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--card-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color .15s; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)) 30%, transparent); } .ds-card:has(a:focus-visible) { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); } .ds-card-img { aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--muted, oklch(0.97 0 0)); margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-brand, .ds-card-sum, .ds-card-stock { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); } .ds-card-name { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-card-name a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; outline: none; } .ds-card-name a::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; } .ds-card-name a:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-card-price { margin: 4px 0 0; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-fit { margin: 4px 0 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #047857; }

narrative.overview:
PC Silicon is a tidy builder's bench. The surfaces are white and calm, the tools (filters, quantity steppers, Add to build) sit in reach without shouting, and what stands out is the work itself: the parts, their prices, and whether they fit. Everything is black ink on white paper, set in Geist with tight negative tracking, on softly rounded 14px corners. The one dark object on the bench is the home page's dot-gridded hero panel, which works like the dark mat a builder lays a motherboard on.

The density is compact, from the shadcn `base-mira` style: 28px controls, 12–14px text in working areas, generous 80px gaps only between home-page sections. Brand lives in precise details (the light-and-bold weight mix in the hero, the `pc`**silicon** wordmark with its globe-and-chip mark, tabular numerals on prices), not in color. Color appears only when it means something: whether a part fits, is out of stock, or has failed.

Dark mode is fully supported (`next-themes`, system default, the `d` key toggles it), and every neutral has a dark counterpart in `app/globals.css`.
keyCharacteristics: Strictly monochrome neutrals; semantic color only for fit, stock and error states.
Flat surfaces: hairline borders, 1px rings and muted fills, no drop shadows.
Geist throughout, with negative tracking on headings and tabular numbers on prices.
Compact controls (28px) with a solid, clearly visible focus ring.
One dark panel (the hero) and one animated element (the PC Builder shimmer button).

rules.name: The Ink-Only Rule
rules.body: The brand is black and white. No accent color exists, so none is introduced, whether for links, highlights, charts or decoration. Charts use the grey `chart-1…5` ramp.

rules.name: The Color Means Something Rule
rules.body: Red, green and amber appear only on a state the user must understand (fit, stock, error), and always together with text and an icon, never as color alone.

rules.name: The Tabular Price Rule
rules.body: Every price uses `tabular-nums`, formatted with `formatPeso()`. A struck list price beside a sale price is announced as "Was …".

rules.name: The Two-Weight Hero Rule
rules.body: Display type is light (300) with bold (700) words. Use the real variable weights; never synthesize light from 400.

rules.name: The Flat Bench Rule
rules.body: No `box-shadow` on cards, tiles, panels or overlays. Separation is a border, a ring or a fill. (Known drift: the stock shadcn primitives still ship `shadow-md` on dropdown and select popups and `shadow-lg` on the sheet; remove them when those files are next touched rather than copying them. 1px `shadow-[0_0_0_1px…]` rings in the sidebar are borders, not elevation.)

rules.name: The One Shimmer Rule
rules.body: The PC Builder shimmer button (a light travelling around its border, with an inset highlight) is the only animated, glowing element, and it marks the product's differentiator. It stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`. Don't reuse it for other actions.

dos: Do use the theme tokens (`bg-background`, `text-foreground`, `bg-muted`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border`) so both themes work; fixed neutrals belong only on the hero.
Do pair every status color with text and an icon (`FitLabel`, `StockLine`).
Do use `focusRing` from `@/lib/utils` (a solid 2px ring with a 2px offset) on links and custom controls; the shadcn default at 30% is too faint on its own.
Do set prices in `tabular-nums` with `formatPeso()`, and render product images through `ProductImage` in its Bench Grey square.
Do keep headings tight (−0.02em or tighter) and body text at normal tracking.
Do separate surfaces with a 1px border, a 10% ring or a Bench Grey fill.
donts: Don't introduce an accent color, gradient or tinted brand hue anywhere, including links, charts or Admin. (The dark-mode `--sidebar-primary` in `globals.css` is still shadcn's blue, `oklch(0.488 0.243 264.376)`; it is a leftover, not part of the palette.)
Don't add drop shadows to cards, tiles, dialogs or panels.
Don't reuse the shimmer effect beyond the PC Builder entry point, or animate anything that ignores `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Don't use green, amber or red for decoration or emphasis; they are reserved for fit, stock and errors.
Don't add icons, borders or images to category tiles, or buttons and labels to the hero.
Don't show fake trust marks (ratings, review stars, registration badges); the store has none.
